title: Role audit
idea: Role audit: Principal role and scope are compared against actual resource access
audience: People who need to review access within a dashboard surface.
avoidWhen: Global and tenant access are conflated
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic workspace layout through its review access priority and explicit commitment contract: Privilege changes require server authorization and audit
navigation: Role audit keeps the current review access context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Principal role and scope are compared against actual resource access
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to review access; admins inspect delegated permissions
composition.priority: Privilege changes require server authorization and audit

imagery.role: Support the actual review access context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Use a focused principal scope view instead of squeezed matrix
Keep units, filters and selection understandable at narrow widths; expose a focused item view.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the role audit structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no review access content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Privilege changes require server authorization and audit
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized review access content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Privilege changes require server authorization and audit
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active review access context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure bounded queries and large-data interaction; virtualize only with accessible alternatives.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
